cells: Operator-generated Grok Imagine tileable room-finish textures, image_gen session `01a0e84c-516a-79a0-ba8b-3dd958c2e1ea` (`/Users/patrick/.grok/sessions/%2FVolumes%2Ffiles%2Fsrc%2Fopenclinxr-wt%2Fimagine-texture-generation/01a0e84c-516a-79a0-ba8b-3dd958c2e1ea/images/`): `1.jpg` (ceiling tile face, kept attempt 1, md5 bf3bfc4326f3b775fd24260587094d39), `2.jpg` (floor vinyl, kept attempt 1, md5 e5c135c3530f866f2aacd3c24dab69be), `3.jpg` (wall plaster, kept attempt 1, md5 734fe96c282446a18bba7d1e1527b35e), `5.jpg` (door maple, kept attempt 2, md5 f26ca3e8e0d124c05e8f3bda9f203f3d). Filed as `packages/openclinxr/factory-stations/src/room_clinic_finish/textures/ceiling-tile-face.jpg`, `floor-vinyl.jpg`, `wall-plaster.jpg`, `door-maple.jpg` (bytes copied unchanged, all 1024x1024 JPEG). Session `4.jpg` (door maple attempt 1, REJECTED: two large near-mirrored cathedral arches read as a repeating stamp artefact, md5 bb27b98e5c914a2f43cb0eeee5bce901) is kept only as `textures/rejected/door-maple-rejected-attempt1.jpg` and is never processed or loaded. Full prompts and screening per texture: `docs/openclinxr/room-realism/imagine-textures-2026-09-28/manifest.json`.

**OPERATOR-GENERATED — not third-party.** Produced with Grok Imagine (`image_gen`, aspect_ratio 1:1, native tool, no driver selector, seed not exposed) and approved as the room-realism texture working set. No external licence applies; no attribution obligation. Grok Imagine platform rights terms were not independently re-verified beyond the row-30/row-31 precedent. Recorded here so the byte lineage of the filed texture set is explicit.

4 kept albedo sources plus deterministic derivatives per source: `<base>-tileable.jpg` (offset-by-half wrap + center-seam cosine heal, JPEG q95), `<base>-normal.png` (Rec.709 heightfield, wraparound Sobel 3x3, strength 2.0), `<base>-roughness.png` (inverted normalized 5x5 local luminance stddev), and `docs/openclinxr/room-realism/imagine-textures-2026-09-28/preview-2x2-<base>.jpg` grading previews (JPEG q90). Exact parameters and per-file md5s: `derivation-params.json` in the same job dir; regeneration script `textures/make_imagine_textures_tileable.py` (Pillow 12.3.0, numpy 2.5.1).

Staged, not yet consumed: `room_clinic_finish/compose.py` still loads `floor-vinyl.jpg` / `door-maple.jpg` (now the new tileable-source bytes) and `ceiling-tile-face.png` (procedural, unchanged); wiring the `-tileable` / `-normal` / `-roughness` derivatives into the material/shader/bake path is the follow-up ceiling-wiring job. Note: `floor-vinyl.jpg` (previous md5 cb03916b2d587d026efcb295c096cfc2) and `door-maple.jpg` (previous md5 defa9611aa2afb55987bd30b8a59b357) previously held row-30-era bytes; those bytes remain recoverable from git history (superseded at this row's commit).
**Keep.** Operator-owned source, approved working set. Replace only if the operator supplies a new approved set.
